nina (partnerships): Partner asked for a tiny SEV path for their SI integration. They want an action list and a pasteable initial post. Can we finalize?

liam (partner-success): Short, please. They will forward to their oncall.

omar (eng-sre): Proposed: 1) Post to #partner-<vendor>-sev, tag @redwood-partner-oncall. 2) If ack within 10m -> triage in-channel. 3) If no ack or SEV1 -> ping @redwood-sre-oncall and open bridge. 4) Invite security/legal if data issue.

zara (solutions): Add required fields: tenant_id, 2 sample request_ids, model, timestamp, short impact (users affected). Also include fallback model name.

ops-bot: Reminder: private channel needs legal approval: https://legal.redwood.example/partner-channels

liam (partner-success): I'll get legal signoff and send their oncall the pasteable snippet.

omar (eng-sre): Pasteable initial post (copy/paste):

```text
SEV1: 503s for tenant=<tenant_id>
Samples: <req1>, <req2>
Model: <model_name>
Impact: <brief>
Please ack and join #partner-<vendor>-sev. Contact: @redwood-partner-oncall
```

nina (partnerships): Great. Deliverables: one-page for partner, internal runbook update, and walkthrough with their oncall. Scheduling now. :thumbsup:
